title: Devil's Candy
description: A struggling painter is possessed by satanic forces after he and his family move into their dream home.

title: Good Madam
description: The aftershocks of apartheid reverberate through a South African family as a daughter tries to free her mother from the grip of her mysterious employer.

title: A Banquet
description: A widowed mother is radically tested when her teenage daughter insists a supernatural experience has left her body in service to a higher power.

title: The Reef
description: A sailing trip becomes a disaster for a group of friends when the boat sinks and a white shark hunts the helpless passengers.

title: Mandrake
description: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

title: PG: Psycho Goreman
description: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

title: Color Out of Space
description: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

title: Party Hard Die Young
description: A fun vacation quickly turns into a nightmare for a group of friends visiting Croatia.

title: Vicious Fun
description: A horror film critic finds himself in a sticky situation when he stumbles into a self-help group for serial killers.

title: Prevenge
description: A pregnant woman kills an assortment of people.

title: Random Acts of Violence
description: Comic book writers discover horrific events are related to a character they created.

title: Superdeep
description: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

title: The Angry Black Girl and Her Monster
description: Vicaria is a brilliant teenager who believes death is a disease that can be cured. After the brutal murder of her brother, she embarks on a dangerous journey to bring him back to life.

title: Birth/Rebirth
description: A morgue technician reanimates the body of a little girl, but must harvest biological materials from pregnant women to keep her breathing. When the girl's mother, a nurse, discovers her baby is alive, the two make a dark deal.

title: Dark Match
description: A small-time wrestling company accepts a well-paying gig in a backwoods town only to learn that the community is run by a mysterious cult leader with devious plans for their match.

title: Dead Mail
description: A post office employee investigates the mysterious origins of a blood-stained note that was sent by a captive man.

title: Grafted
description: An ambitious yet socially inexperienced exchange student strives to elevate her status in pursuit of popularity.

title: Shadow of God
description: While performing an unauthorized exorcism on his father, an elite exorcist suspects the entity he is battling with might be a holy being, perhaps even God.

title: Suitable Flesh
description: Psychiatrist Elizabeth Derby becomes obsessed with helping a young patient who's suffering from extreme personality disorder. However, it soon leads her into occult danger as she tries to escape from a horrific fate.

title: Children of the Corn
description: Possessed by a spirit in a dying cornfield, a 12-year-old girl in Nebraska recruits other children in her small town to go on a bloody rampage and kill all the adults and anyone else who opposes her.

title: The Devil's Bath
description: Agnes does not feel at home in her husband's world. A shocking act seems for her to be the only way out.

title: Offseason
description: Upon receiving a mysterious letter, a woman returns to the isolated offshore island where her mother is buried. Left stranded, she realizes that something is not quite right as she must unveil the mystery of her mother's past to make it out alive.

title: The Reef: Stalked
description: Hoping to heal from a tragedy, a woman and her friends embark on a kayaking and diving adventure in tropical waters. However, the fun soon turns to terror when they find themselves fighting for their lives against a great white shark.

title: Resurrection
description: A woman's carefully constructed life gets upended when an unwelcome shadow from her past returns, forcing her to confront the monster she's evaded for two decades.

title: Slash/Back
description: Maika and her ragtag group of friends discover an alien invasion in their tiny arctic hamlet, and it's up to them to fight back using makeshift weapons and horror movie knowledge.

title: The Innocents
description: Terror strikes when a group of Nordic children reveals mysterious powers that take a dark and violent turn.

title: She Will
description: An aging film star retreats to the Scottish countryside with her nurse to recover from surgery. While there, mysterious forces of revenge emerge from the land where witches were burned.

title: Baghead
description: A young woman inherits a run-down pub and discovers a dark secret within its basement, Baghead, a shape-shifting creature that lets one speak to lost loved ones, but not without consequence.

title: Daddy's Head
description: A boy and his widowed stepmother find themselves in fear for their lives after they are visited by an unexplainable creature which appears to mimic the boy's recently deceased father.

title: MadS
description: Romain sees an injured woman and decides to help her, but when she gets in his car, she suddenly smashes her own head against the dashboard, bleeding out until she dies.

title: Black Cab
description: After a night out, a couple are kidnapped by their black cab driver. Terrified, he drives them to a deserted and supposedly haunted road.

title: Brooklyn 45
description: Best friends since childhood, five military veterans gather to support their troubled host, and the metaphoric ghosts of their past become all-too-literal.

title: The Communion Girl
description: After moving to a new town, a teenage girl tries to fit in with other teens but meets a terrifying ghost.

title: Deadstream
description: A disgraced internet personality tries to win back his followers by livestreaming himself at an abandoned haunted house. When he accidentally unleashes a vengeful spirit, his comeback event becomes a fight for his life.

title: Elevator Game
description: A teen links the mysterious disappearance of his sister to a supernatural game that's played in elevators.

title: Night of the Hunted
description: When Alice stops at a remote gas station at night, she's made the plaything of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta. To survive, she must figure out who wants her dead.

title: Nightmare
description: Mona and Robbie move into their first apartment when Mona starts experiencing horrible nightmares. As the bad dreams intensify, it is clear something is making its way into the world through Mona.

title: The Puppetman
description: A convicted killer on death row maintains his innocence. His daughter suspects there is truth to her father's claim when her loved ones begin to die in brutal ways.

title: Skinamarink
description: Two children wake up in the middle of the night to find their father is missing, and all the windows and doors in their home have vanished.

title: Sorry About the Demon
description: A young man struggling with a broken heart learns that his new place is full of restless spirits.

title: Spoonful of Sugar
description: A disturbed babysitter experiences a sexual awakening while using LSD to treat a seemingly sick child from a family with dark secrets.

title: The Unheard
description: After undergoing an experimental procedure to restore her damaged hearing, 20-year-old Chloe Grayden begins to suffer from auditory hallucinations seemingly related to the mysterious disappearance of her mother.

title: V/H/S/85
description: A heart-pounding journey into the grim underbelly of the forgotten '80s through five tales of terror on a taped-over made-for-TV documentary.

title: Watcher
description: As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
